name: yao-doubao-crawler
input_files: required collection inputs: keywords/questions and repeat count
required diagnosis inputs: target entity and entity type
optional brands.txt/entities.txt alias and competitor file
optional Android/Appium backend fields: device, app package, app activity, Appium server, fresh-chat controls
output_contract: summary.json analysis metrics with target entity recognition, same-type competitor comparison, and mobile_evidence when present
structured-data.md Markdown export of cleaned structured fields and analysis tables
structured-data.xlsx Excel workbook with the same structured sheets as the Markdown export

report.html Kami-styled visual report with overview, directory, metric explanations, entity classification, probability tables, target-vs-competitor module, visible source/title analysis, clickable citations with unique compact URL labels when URLs are exposed, GEO trend projections, and capped detail lists
result.mobile_search_materials Android audit evidence for visible search-material rows, cited/uncited flags, citation counts, and detail artifacts
analysis-stage mobile_evidence tables for fresh-chat counts, search-material rows, cited/uncited material rows, and per-sample evidence
mobile screenshots/* and xml/* per-screen evidence when Android/Appium backend is used
rollback_boundary: The skill writes local artifacts only to the selected run output directory. Fresh web crawling creates Doubao web conversations in the connected browser session. Fresh mobile crawling sends prompts in the selected logged-in Android app session and writes screenshots/XML locally. It does not modify external source projects, bypass login, or use hidden APIs.
local_dependencies: Doubao web session that can send messages
Bundled scripts/doubao_browser_crawl.mjs using the OpenCLI doubao adapter
Optional Android SDK Platform-Tools adb for mobile backend
Optional Appium 3 with UiAutomator2 driver for mobile backend
Optional Appium-Python-Client from requirements-mobile.txt for mobile backend
Optional logged-in Doubao Android app session for mobile backend
